The wildcard certificate for the staging domain expires in November and is the only one without automatic renewal, because it needs a DNS challenge. Set up the DNS-01 challenge with a scoped token and let the renewal job handle it.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] scoped DNS token created
- [ ] dry-run renewal succeeds
- [ ] expiry alert added
